name: Niizuma Tamaki ~Tamaki no Aisai Nikki + Harem End no Sorekara~
original_name: 新妻環 ～環の愛妻日記 ＋ハーレムＥＮＤのそれから～
source: Sequel to Tamaki’s route from the original game this Fan Disk relates to; Soushirou has succeeded in becoming Tsukidade’s renowned ceramist, and married his daughter Tamaki while at it; it has been four years since Soushirou and Tamaki met each other, she has grown into an even more beautiful lady, the couple enjoy their fulfilling marriage with their little baby daughter Towa. This blooming family life is recorded every day in Tamaki’s Picture Diary.
translation: 这是与本作相关的原作游戏中Tamaki路线的续作粉丝向资料片。Soushirou成功成为Tsukidade著名的陶艺家，并与其女儿Tamaki结婚；两人相识已经四年，Tamaki出落得更加美丽，夫妻俩和年幼的女儿Towa享受着充实的婚姻生活。这段欣欣向荣的家庭生活，每天都记录在Tamaki的绘图日记中。
